ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(this"Agreement"), made as of December 10, 2021 ("Effective Date"), between Islandbridge Development LLC, having an address at 128 Greenpoint Avenue,Brooklyn,NY 11222 (hereinafter referred to as the "Owner") and Starpoint Developnient LLC, having an address at 132 Greenpoint Avenue, Suite B1,Brooklyn,NY 11222 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner infee title ofa certain parcel ofland.with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as Block 2563, Tax Lots 28 and more particularly described by metes and bound in Exhibit “A"(hereinafter known as “Parcel A"). WHEREAS,Developer is the owner in fee title of a certainparcel ofland. with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as Block 2563, Tax Lots 29 and more particularly described by metes and bound in Exhibit“B"(hereinafter known as“Parcel B"). WHEREAS, in contemplation of construction of a new building upon Parcel B （said newbuilding.with any furtheradditions,alterations andreplacementsthereof, being herein called the"New Building"), Owner/Developer's prior common owner, 132 Greenpoint LLC (hereinafter referred to as the “Grantor") utilized the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution to separate Parcels A and B of Grantor's Property into separate“zoning lots”for the purpose of ensuring that theNew Building's floor area (herein referred to as *Floor Area"), as that term is defined in section 12 -10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork effective December15, 1961 (the “Zoning Resolution") complies with the “floor area ratio" limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution. WHEREAS,there exist unused“Available FloorArea DevelopmentRights" (hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner's Property comprising Parcel A and B which is in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized on the Owner's Property as of the Effective Date. As used in this Agreement, the term “Floor Area Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenantto a zoning lot, to develop such zoninglot by erectingthereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use,

bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, in order to construct the New Building on Parcel B, Owner intends to both reserve and use on or pertinent to Parcel B, all Available Development Rights from the Owner's Property pursuant to the terins of this Agreement. As used in this Agreement,"“Available Development Rights" shall mean all Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner's Property minus the Floor Area now attributable to the building existing on Parcel A as of the Effective Date shall include any and all development rights resulting from any upward revision of the Floor Area Development Rights and any and all development rights and other benefits which may become available including additional Floor Development Rights resulting from a floor area bonus. Owner has reserved to itself, solely in its capacity as the owner of Parcel B and any successor in interest in Parcel B (collectively *"Parcel B Owners") the right to utilize all AvailableDevelopment Rights,on the terms and conditions hereinafterset forth,it beingunderstood and agreed,however,that Owner, solely in its capacity as the owner of Parcel A, is retaining for its own benefit all Retained Development Rights. Except where "Owner” is reserving rights in Section 2.1 and 2.2, any reference in the body of this Agreeinent to "Owner” shall hereinafter refer to Owner in its sole capacity as the owner of Parcel A. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the partieshereto agree as follows: ARTICLEI INTENTIONALLY OMITTED ARTICLEII DEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section 2.1. Owner hereby reserves to theParcel B Owners,all Available Development Rights from the Owner's Property and consents to Parcel B Owners' incorporationoftheAvailableDevelopmentRightsinto theNewBuildingonParcel B and the Parcel B Owners’utilization of the Available Development Rights to developParcel B or the Parcel B Owner's disposition of the Available Development Rights.Owner,solely in its capacity as theowner ofParcel A,shall retain all Retained Development Rights attributable to the building now existing on Parcel A as the same exists on the Effective Date, and the Parcel B Owners shall have no rights with respect to any of the Retained Development Rights.
